text:
Alex P: Quick thread to capture H2 planning for long-term routing + multi-tenant isolation. Customers (Fico, TruSource) want stronger SLAs and per-tenant isolation options. Need to align on priorities, launch criteria, and deps. :eyes:
Maria G: TL;DR what are the candidate initiatives?
Alex P: High level: 1) Policy DSL + validation (authoritative routing rules) 2) Isolation tiers (shared, soft-isolate, dedicated) 3) Cross-region failover + residency controls 4) Cost-aware routing (route by cost/latency) 5) Rollout/canary primitives integrated with Console.
Chris L: From infra: we can prototype isolation tiers by Q3 if scope limited to scheduling + tenant pinning. Biggest unknown is p95 latency uplift for small seq lengths. Need perf baseline by end of sprint.
Priya S: Product asks: launch criteria we should promise to customers: - p95 latency delta vs hosted baseline < 20% - unit cost overhead < 12% - ability to define per-tenant fallback policy - Ops playbook for eviction/soft-evict - Audit logs & KMS compatibility
Maria G: Customers also asked for a simple UI flow: "Create isolation lane -> assign tenants -> set fallback org policy". That maps to DSL work + Console.
Chris L: Technical risk: strict isolation means less batching and worse unit cost. Suggest we define isolation profiles: soft-isolate (prefers dedicated, allows spillover), hard-isolate (no spillover). Each profile should surface estimated cost multiplier in Console.
Alex P: Good. Also need gating criteria for Dedicated vs Private: Dedicated = reserved GPU pools (SLA), Private = customer-managed infra. Launch paths differ.
Priya S: Can we capture a quick policy example for the DSL?
Priya S: ```
route {
  match tenant: "trusource"
  isolation: "hard-isolate"
  fallback: { type: "regional_shared", max_spill: 0 }
  sloa: { p95_latency_ms: 120 }
}
```
Maria G: Nice. Add evals that run stored prompt-sets to ensure quality parity when we route to quantized / cheaper variants.
Chris L: Action items from infra: 1) baseline perf matrix for seq len 8/64/512 across shared vs soft/hard isolation (due EOW) 2) cost model delta for each profile (due next Tue) 3) quick sim of spillover behavior under 2x burst (due next Wed)
Alex P: Action items from product: 1) Draft launch acceptance checklist (SLOs, cost thresholds, Console UX flows, audit/logging) 2) Customer sandbox onboarding plan (TruSource pilot) 3) Canaries & rollback playbook. Target initial checklist by next Thurs.
Maria G: Dependencies: SRE needs tracing hooks + tenant-level tracing retention config. Legal wants data residency knobs clearly documented before pilot.
Chris L: SRE/infra note: we'll need a new metric: tenant_affinity_breaks (counter) + isolated_evictions (counter). Add to Console telemetry.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for branch "isolation-prototype" on prod-sandbox at 2025-08-12T16:00Z :white_check_mark:
Alex P: For prioritization exercise: propose we rank by customer-revenue impact x implementation risk. I think DSL + soft-isolate first (low risk, high ROI), hard-isolate follow (higher cost/risk). Thoughts?
Priya S: +1. Soft first enables pilots and we can iterate on cost signals. Also surface estimated cost to customers upfront.
Maria G: Agree. Also note: gating for GA: run 2 customer pilots (one enterprise, one mid-market) for 6 weeks each, no data loss incidents, and quantitative cost/latency report.
Alex P: Ok team — I'll synthesize into a one-pager with decision matrix and ship to product + infra leads by EOD. If anyone has strong objections, flag here. :shipit:
Chris L: No objections. Will post perf numbers to this thread when ready.
Priya S: I'll start the checklist draft and attach UX mockups in Confluence.
Maria G: Adding Legal contact (emailed) for residency docs.
Alex P: Thanks everyone.
